headline: Home sides win all three meetings between members so far
dek: Franklin Pierce, Assumption and American International have each beaten a fellow member, and every one of the three wins came at home. Assumption's thirteen goals now match Franklin Pierce's, and only Southern New Hampshire, with twenty, have scored more.

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Thirteen different players have scored Southern New Hampshire's twenty goals, while Franklin Pierce and Assumption reach the same thirteen by different routes: four scorers at Franklin Pierce, six at Assumption.

wire.line: Southern New Hampshire have scored twenty and conceded three, and nobody has beaten them yet.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Saint Michael's have conceded eleven goals, more than any other programme, and have lost three of their six matches.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Southern Connecticut remain the only programme without a win, with two draws and two defeats from four matches after losing at home to Mercy.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Pace are unbeaten after five matches, and only three goals have gone past them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Cody Holbert has scored six goals from twenty-four shots, more goals than any other player listed.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Andrea Farinella has made twenty-four saves, more than any other goalkeeper listed.

last_match.line: Adelphi have not lost since the opening week; Caldwell had already beaten Saint Michael's and lost at Bentley.

next_match.line: Another meeting between members, and the home side has won every one so far; Bentley lost the last of them at Franklin Pierce.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
